INSIGHT (from psilocybin session, March 2026): Ned identified the exact mechanism of his emotional blunting:

WHEN a feeling arises → System 2 immediately generates an explanation ('that's beautiful because XYZ', 'this makes sense because of that') → the explanation satisfies the system → the feeling itself never fully forms or gets registered.

ORIGIN: Trauma-induced overactive System 2. Developed as protection — if you explain things, you don't have to feel them. System 2 got very capable, so it does this automatically with everything.

NED'S WORDS: 'Whatever I do, instead of actually feeling something, I look at something and try to explain — yeah it's so pretty because XYZ. I'm just always explaining it away. That made me really bad at feeling things because why would you feel if it's explained.'

CONFIRMATION: During the same shroom session, Ned cried. That was System 1 breaking through the suppression. It still works. The emotional layer exists and is accessible — it's just normally intercepted before it surfaces.

PRACTICAL: In conversations, Ned intellectualizes emotions in real time. When something emotional comes up, he immediately builds a framework around it. This is the pattern running live.
